tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos thos pa'i rgya mtsho rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti pra dza bh+ya/…… skye dgu rnams bde legs su gyur cig ka lak+ṣ+mī dzi ne na dzña nu kam+pa bhā nu/ au da ra dhar+m+mā ta tha tā su dhāṃ kaḥ pa ṭ+win+t+ra ya s+yāk+ṣa ra shi mu ṣā+e dza/ ka l+yā ṇa sau dā ra u dā ya kā raṃ/ phun tshogs rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse pad+mo'i gnyen/ /gru chen chos kyi ded dpon 'od dkar can/ /gang nyid blo gros 'chi med lam yangs por/ /dbang po rdo rje dge legs 'char mdzad mkhas pa'i dbang po rgyal/ dpal ldan kun tu bzang po'i gsung rab 'bum phrag du ma'i sa mtsho mar 'khrungs dri med mkhyen pa'i chu bo rab rgyas shing / /dpag yas skye dgu'i tshogs rnams phan bde mchog la nye bar 'god mdzad gcig tu dkar ba'i thugs rje'i (pad+ma bla )ko sha/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i 'ching ba kun nas grol byed mthu ldan nus pa'i 'bras bu'i khur gyis rab tu lci ba'i mañdzu ṣa/ /srid zhi'i dpal yon rnam rgyas 'dab can dbang po bhū mi paṇ+ḍu bhaṭ+ṭā ra ga sa gsum lha mi'i gtsug gis mchod/ /phan bdes 'gro kun dga' mdzad snying po'i chos/ /rab rgyas bsod nams rtse mor phyin pa'i bka'/ sa skya'i rje btsun/…… /snyan grags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas pa'i/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /bde legs kun 'byung 'phags pa blo gros mtshan/ /bstan pa'i khur 'chang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs/ /yan lag mchog gis rab tu mchod par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ches dkon gdam pa rnams/ /mchog tu 'phel mdzad rje btsun gang de nyid/ /'bras med snying gi pad+mar rtag bzhugs nas/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos brtse chen bla ma yi/ /bka' yi phreng ba bsam 'phel nor bu las/ /dgos 'dod chos char 'bebs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/

/rna ba'i dga' ston 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /'dir byang phyogs kha ba'i ljongs ku mu da rnam par bzhad pa'i tshal du/ nges par legs pa'i lam la gcig tu gzhol zhing / lhag pa'i tshul khrims ngur smrig gi spu sdug rab tu mdzes la/ legs par bshad pa'i mkhyen pa'i rdza rnga phyogs su snyan par sgrogs pas/ rang gzhan rnam par grol ba'i bdud rtsi thos par 'dod pa dag gis/ dam pa'i chos thos nas nyams su len zhing / gzhan la phan pa gtso bor byed pa rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyi mdzad pa'i tshul/ gzhal du med pa dag gi rjes su 'jug pa la brtson par bya dgos shing / kho bo cag gi yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams las de ltar thos pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ de yang bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i ngo bo sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len du 'dus pas/ thog mar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa rim gyis nod pa'i tshul ni/ rang lo bcu gcig lon pa shing mo yos kyi lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs la/ chos kyi rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob cing / rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs la'ang gnas par byas la lo de nyid kyi mjug rgyal gyi zla ba'i yar ngo'i ches bcu gnyis gyi nyi ma phyed ma yol tsam gyi tshod rkang pa gsum gyi dus su shrī e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du bdag cag gi 'dren mchog dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan zhing / sku gsung thugs gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i bdag nyid/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel ba'i drung du mkhan po zhus shing / chos rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon mdzad nas/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnams pa dag pa thob/

lo nyi shu lon pa mig dmar zhes pa/ shing pho byi ba'i lo/ nyi ma seng ge'i khyim du zhugs pa/ gros bzhin gyi zla ba'i gral tshes nyi shu'i nyin grib tshod rgas pa gnyis dang / skyes bu gcig gis dus su/ mkhan po sngar gyi de nyid/ las gyi slob dpon byang chub kyi sems gnyis la thugs brtan pa thob pa chos kyi rje sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab can yon tan 'byung gnas pas/ gsang sde ston pa'i slob dpon mdzad de/ dge 'dun lnga'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa tshul bzhin du nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha shākya mu nīn+d+ra/……yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i dbang po/ shā ri pu tra/……shā ri'ibu/ pu tra rā hu la shī bha dra/……sras sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bzang po/ bra h+ma ṇa ra nu la bha dra/……bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ ār+ya na gardzu na/……'phags pa klu sgrub/ gu ṇa mi tra/……yon tan bshes gnyen/ dharma mi tra/……rin chen bshes gnyen/ dharma swa la/……chos kyi bzang po/ gu ṇa pa ti/……yon tan bdag po/ dhar+m+ma mā la/……chos kyi phreng ba/ ā kā ra gup+ta/……'byung gnas spas pa/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra/……mkhas pa chen po shākya shrī dpal bzang po/ ma ha sā dhā ya badz+ra shrī/……mkhan chen rdo rje dpal/ rasmi shrī/……'od zer dpal/ puṇ+ya shrī/……bsod nams dpal/ maṅga la shī la/……bkra shis tshul khrims/ dhar+m+ma sā mi hā na dh+wa dza/……chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ badz+ra dha ra a nan+da bha dra/……rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ dak+ṣi sid+dha shrī wa badz+ra/……mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ sa de ba dza gan+dā tha sha ra ṇaṃ rat+na war+dha/……lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs dkon mchog 'phel/ bhū mi paṇ+ṭu lo tsa mañdzu gho ṣā danan+da pu ṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dre ṇa prasti/……sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/

theg pa chen po dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed tshar gnyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ma hā mu ni/……theg pa chen po/ bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka mañdzu gho ṣa/……rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ ār+ya nā gārdzu na/……'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/……'phags pa lha/ nā ga bo dhi/……klu'i byang chub/ tsan+d+ra kirti/……zla ba grags pa/ shrī k+ṣa badz+ra/……slob pa'i rdo rje/ dze tra ra/……dgra las rnam rgyal/ ma hā badz+ra sa na shā ka shī/……rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ ma dha ma badz+ra sa nā mo badz+ra/……rdo rje gdan pa 'bring po don yod rdo rje/ ulpa badz+ra sa na pu ṇ+ya shrī/……rdo rje gdan pa chung ba bsod nams dpal/ lo tsā rat+na kirti/……lo tsā ba rin grags/ shrī ma hā bhu mi paṇ+ḍu a nan+da gar+bha/……dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ ātsār+ya rat+na puṇ+ya gra/……slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ bhaṭ+ṭa ra ga rat+na kīrti dh+wa dza/……rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bhu mi paṇ+ḍu paṇ+ḍi ta nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……sa skya pa mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ ār+ya ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mañdzu gho ṣa kā ru ṇa rat+na/……'jam dbyangs 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ bo dhi satwa rat+na nā tha/……byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mgon po/ dza ya pu tra saṅga bha dra shrī/……rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal/ lo tsā ba bodh+ya gra/……lo tsā ba byang chub (dge che ) dhar+m+ma swa mi dzñā na dh+wa dza/……chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ badz+ra dha ranan+da bha dra/……rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ ma hā satwa rat+na dh+wa dza/……mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sid+dhe shwa ra nan+de shwa ra/……grub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' dbang phyug sa de ba dza gad+na tha sha ra ṇaṃ rat+na war+dha/……lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs dkon mchog 'phel/ des bdag sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/

/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa tshul bzhin du legs par thob pa ni/ thog mar dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang ldan pa/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba tshang bar thob nas/ de'i brgyud pa ni dza ya badz+ra dha ra/……rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka badz+ra nai rat+mā/……rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ yo ge shwa ra bi ru pa/……rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa/ ātsār+ya kāh+na pa/slob dpon nag po pa/ de sha ma dh+ya ma s+ya dzo gi ……yul dbus kyi rnal 'byor pa/ bhaṭ+ṭā ra kā wa dhū ti/……rje btsun gnyis spangs/ paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī dzñā na/……mkhas pa rin chen dpal ye shes/ lo tsā shākya dzñā na/……lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ gu ru sarba bid/……bla ma kun rig gu ru dhar+m+ma dz+wa la/……bla ma chos 'bar/ ma hā bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ā nan+da gar+bha/……sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ ā tsār+ya rat+na pu ṇ+ya gra/……slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka rat+na kīrti dh+wa dza/……rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bhū mi paṇ+ḍu paṇ+ḍi tā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……sa skya pa mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ār+ya ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rat+na shrī ……dkon mchog dpal/ puṇ+ya shrī ……bsod nams dpal/ saṅgu ru pu ṇ+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ shrī wān shī la ……dpal ldan tshul khrims/ dhar+m+ma swā mi dzñā na dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ badz+ra dha rā nan+da bha dra/……rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ ma hā satwa rat+na dh+wa dza ……sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sid+dhe shwa rā nan+de shwa ra/……grub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' dbang phyug sa de ba dza gad+nā tha sha ra ṇaṃ rat+na war+dha ……lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs dkon mchog 'phel/

bhū mi paṇ+ḍu lo tsā mañdzu gho ṣā nan+da puṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dre ṇa shru ti ……sa skya lo tsa ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thos so/ /rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i dbang chu chen mo/ /rab gnas bzang po drug pa/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma lnga bcu pa'i ṭī ka kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bstod pa dan ḍa ka kye rdor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis rnams kyi lung thob bo/ /bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang bskur ba tshar gnyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ ne tse sbal ston/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam pa ra chos shes/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ de la chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang / bla ma blo gros brtan pa gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka la bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pas gsan/ de la bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'phel/ de la bdag sa skya lo tsā bas thos so/ /rdo rje bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od ḍoṃ bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ yang bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs mi thub zla bas mdzad pa/ dkyil chog ne tse sbal ston gyis mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i bstod pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rigs 'dzin grags kyi mchan dang bcas pa/ 'grel pa sa paṇa gyi mdzad pa rnams kyi lung yang thob bo// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/
